index.title: Tibia Calculators
index.subtitle: 14 free tools for planning training, valuing your character and analysing results.

exercise-weapons.title: Exercise Weapons
exercise-weapons.description: Calculate how many exercise weapons you need for a target skill — with loyalty, double event and TC threshold.

skills.title: Training / Skills
skills.description: Time and cost to train from current to target skill on any weapon.

true-skill.title: True Skill
true-skill.description: Convert the displayed skill with loyalty bonus to base skill — the same value shown in highscores and Bazaar.

blessings.title: Blessings
blessings.description: Blessing cost and XP-loss protection at your level.

stamina.title: Stamina
stamina.description: Time to full stamina in hunt and offline modes — premium bonuses and regeneration windows included.

character-value.title: Character Value
character-value.description: Character valuation in TC: skills, features, progression, cosmetics and assets — with expandable breakdown.

imbuement.title: Imbuement cost
imbuement.description: Basic / Powerful / Epic tier costs per imbuement and astral source requirements.

weekly-tasks.title: Weekly Tasks
weekly-tasks.description: Maximum XP per weekly task by level and difficulty (Beginner / Adept / Expert / Master).

charms.title: Charms Damage
charms.description: Damage and percent bonus from charms for your vocation, skill and monster type.

experience.title: Experience / Levelling
experience.description: Total XP to a level, delta to target, and time at a given XP/h.

leech.title: Leech
leech.description: Leech percent from a party accounting for level differences between members.

exp-share.title: Exp Share
exp-share.description: XP split in a party using Tibia's formula based on level distance.

planners-charms.title: Charm Planner
planners-charms.description: Optimal charm point allocation for your vocation and build with a shareable link.

planners-wheel.title: Wheel of Destiny Planner
planners-wheel.description: Wheel of Destiny builds per vocation — with descriptions and gem recommendations.

layout.calculatorNotFoundDescription: This calculator does not exist yet or is under construction.

resultDisplay.emptyDescription: Fill in the form to see the result.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

trueSkill.title: True Skill ★
trueSkill.description: Reverse the loyalty bonus. Compare skills as shown in game with highscores.
trueSkill.infoBody: This calculator is the bridge between calculators and Bazaar. Bazaar shows skills WITHOUT loyalty bonus, the game shows them WITH the bonus.

displayedSkill.label: Skill shown in game
displayedSkill.help: Value from the character status (with loyalty bonus).

recommendations.bazaar: Base skill: {value}. Bazaar will show {value} (without the {discount} bonus).

stamina.title: Stamina
stamina.description: Regeneration time, premium vs free efficiency.

currentStamina.label: Current stamina
currentStamina.help: Value from the character window (in hours).

targetStamina.label: Target stamina
targetStamina.help: Max value for this account: {max} h

isPremium.label: Account status
isPremium.help: Premium = up to 42 h + green zone (Happy Hours). Free = up to 40 h, no green zone.

recommendations.premiumNormal: Premium: {rate} min offline = 1 min stamina in normal zone (0-39 h).
recommendations.free: Free: {rate} min offline = 1 min stamina (no green zone).
recommendations.withGreen: Premium: {normalRate} min/h in normal zone, {greenRate} min/h in green zone 39-42 h.
recommendations.full: Stamina already full ({value} h). Nothing to regenerate.

errors.invalidTarget: Maximum for this account is {max} h

exerciseWeapons.title: Exercise Weapons
exerciseWeapons.description: Calculate how many exercise weapons you need for a target skill (or skill from N weapons). Includes loyalty bonus, double event, private dummy and TC price threshold.

category.label: Vocation / skill pair
category.help: One of 8 pairs from architecture §2.1 — pick the contextual pair for your character.

currentSkill.label: Current skill
currentSkill.help: Base skill (without loyalty bonus) — what Bazaar reports.

percentToNext.label: % to next level
percentToNext.help: Tibia shows %, not points. Enter 0 for a freshly gained level.

targetSkill.label: Target skill
targetSkill.help: The skill level you want to reach.

numWeapons.label: Number of weapons
numWeapons.help: How many exercise weapons you intend to use.

loyaltyPct.label: Loyalty bonus (%)
loyaltyPct.help: Tibia: +5% per 360 loyalty points. Higher bonus = fewer weapons needed.

doubleEvent.label: Double event
doubleEvent.help: During a double event you need 2× fewer weapons for the same effect.

privateDummy.label: Private dummy
privateDummy.help: Demon / Ferumbras / Monk dummy: 10% faster training.

tcPriceThreshold.label: TC price threshold (gp)
tcPriceThreshold.help: TibiaWiki: if 1 TC costs more than 13,889 gp, buy for gold. Default: 13,889.

recommendations.buyGold: Buy for gold — TC price ({tcPrice} gp) exceeds the {threshold} gp threshold.
recommendations.buyTc: Buy with TC — TC price ({tcPrice} gp) is below the {threshold} gp threshold.
recommendations.equal: Both methods cost the same (TC = {tcPrice} gp ≈ {threshold} gp threshold).

errors.invalidTarget: Target skill must be higher than current
errors.invalidNum: Number of weapons must be an integer ≥ 0
errors.invalidLoyalty: Loyalty bonus must be one of 0, 5, 10, …, 50
errors.invalidThreshold: TC price threshold must be a positive number

skills.title: Training / Skills
skills.description: Time and cost to train from current to target skill on any weapon — with a precision warning for non-Regular weapon types.

category.label: Vocation / skill pair
category.help: One of 8 pairs from architecture §2.1 — the contextual skill for your character.

targetSkill.label: Target skill
targetSkill.help: The skill level you want to reach.

percentToNext.label: % to next level
percentToNext.help: Tibia shows %, not points. 0 for a freshly gained level.

weaponType.label: Weapon type
weaponType.help: Only 'Regular' gives a precise time. Other types are approximate (assume full weapon usage).

offline.label: Offline training
offline.help: Offline training consumes stamina — but the time stays the same.

warnings.approximate: Only 'Regular' weapons give a precise time/cost. Other types assume full weapon usage — they may overestimate the result.

recommendations.approximate: TibiaWiki: only 'Regular' weapons give a precise time. The chosen type assumes full weapon usage.
recommendations.precise: 'Regular' weapon — result matches the TibiaWiki Skills Calculator.
